acceptance: Loading of the code skill in the Claude Code harness on Sonnet is reported for the four prompt kinds with no hook.
The gate outcome is recorded: closed with no build, or owner go-ahead quoted.
If built: the hook is committed under deployment/, its test shows one reminder per session and fail-open on error, and the with-hook loading rate and near-miss count are reported against the gate.
If built: a sandbox session in the ablation runner shows the hook does not fire there.
Ledger total is 30 USD or less.
description: Problem: the code-first rule works only in omp. Claude Code sessions (the most used harness for Sonnet main sessions in the owner's logs) get no prompt to load the code skill. Whether Claude Code loads the skill unprompted has not been measured at all: the trigger evaluation ran in omp only. Outcome: a measurement of code-skill loading in Claude Code and, only if it is low and the owner wants it, a PreToolUse hook that does what the omp rule does. Decision gate: first measure the explicit, implicit, contextual and near-miss prompts in the Claude Code harness on Sonnet with no hook. If the skill loads in at least 50% of explicit and implicit sessions, close with the result and build nothing. Otherwise put the numbers to the owner; build the hook only on the owner's go-ahead. Adopt it only if it raises loading to at least 80% of sessions that edit source and fires in 0 near-miss sessions. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe; (2) do not change ~/.omp/agent/config.yml or ~/.omp/agent/rules while sessions run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) write the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision) and commit it before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report, do not raise it without the owner's approval; (5) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (6) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (7) correct an existing report with a dated note, never by silently rewriting a published number; (8) scenario and scratch code that is part of the result is committed with it; (9) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>. Spend ceiling 30 USD. Extra: a hook is added to the user's Claude Code settings only after the owner approves the measured result; the hook must not block or alter the edit beyond one reminder per session, must fail open if it errors, and must not run in the ablation runner's Claude Code sandbox.
